item.title: EC 'dissent' row: Oppn seeks fresh polls, CEC's arrest; BJP lauds 'pure democracy'
item.description: Opposition parties in India are demanding action against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar amid allegations of electoral fraud. Reports indicate that Election Commissioners have raised objections about the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Leaders from various parties are calling for Kumar's resignation and fresh elections in states where elections took place. The BJP defended the Election Commission, emphasizing internal disagreements indicate a democratic process.

item.title: DoorDash agrees to $131.5m after payment errors affected 200,000-plus NYC workers
item.description: DoorDash will pay $131.5 million to settle a probe regarding its payment practices for delivery workers. The settlement will directly benefit over 260,000 Dashers, addressing both missing and late payments. An additional dispute over calculation methods for on-call pay times has also been resolved in this agreement. DoorDash has acknowledged the issues caused by technical errors and improved its payment processes.

item.title: George Floyd’s siblings seek accounting of $14.7m memorial GoFundMe
item.description: After George Floyd's untimely death in 2020, a fundraising campaign on GoFundMe amassed millions to support his family. However, his siblings are now pressing for a comprehensive audit of the funds raised, alleging an inequitable distribution of the contributions. They have called on Philonise Floyd to produce various financial records linked to the campaign. This unfolding situation emphasizes the critical importance of accountability in the handling of considerable charitable donations.

item.title: Scientists 3D-print nearly 2-ton steel mold for NASA aircraft project
item.description: A team at the US Department of Energy’s Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) has spent eight weeks 3D-printing a massive steel mold that stands 6 feet tall, measures 4 feet wide and weighs nearly 2 tons. The tool, developed with Boeing, is designed for manufacturing thermoplastic composite aircraft components and will contribute to NASA’s Hi-Rate Composite Aircraft Manufacturing (HiCAM) project.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
item.description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.

item.title: India's proposal under consideration for safe Black Sea shipping, Zelenskyy says
item.description: India, Egypt, and Turkey are exploring maritime truce options for safe navigation in the Black Sea. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy indicated readiness to support a truce if Russia responds positively. India's External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar is actively engaging with both Ukraine and Russia to mediate the conflict. Disruptions in shipping have impacted grain supplies globally, raising concerns among multiple countries.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Putin says record turnout shows Russians back his military agenda in Ukraine
item.description: Vladimir Putin stated that high voter turnout in the parliamentary election reflects public support for government policies. Preliminary results indicated that United Russia secured a significant majority in the Duma. The election included voting in Ukrainian territories claimed by Russia, which Ukraine considers illegal. Amid ongoing Ukrainian drone attacks, authorities extended voting days and allowed online voting in some regions.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Trump weighs 90-day diesel export ban as US fuel prices hit record high: Report
item.description: The Trump administration is contemplating a 90-day ban on US diesel exports to combat rising energy prices. This initiative comes as diesel prices have surged significantly amid international conflicts and supply disruptions. While some officials oppose the ban, others argue it could create long-term economic consequences. The discussions have intensified due to pressure from Republican lawmakers ahead of the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Africa’s richest man picks Indian PSU for $450 million refinery contract in Kenya
item.description: Aliko Dangote has hired Engineers India Ltd to oversee his $16 billion refinery construction in Kenya. The refinery in Lamu will have a capacity of 700,000 barrels per day when completed. Dangote plans to strengthen regional energy security by reducing reliance on imports through this project. Work is scheduled to begin by the end of September as part of a larger expansion plan.

item.title: One Indian killed after ship attacked off Oman coast; MEA condemns incident
item.description: In a tragic incident off the coast of Oman, the MV Cape Dao was attacked while en route to India, resulting in the death of one Indian seafarer. Nineteen others were successfully rescued, and the Indian Ministry of External Affairs expressed its condolences. The embassy in Oman is actively coordinating the repatriation of the crew, reiterating India's commitment to ensuring safe navigation in international waters.
item.dc:creator: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: IIT-B suicide case: New CCTV footage shows Sahil before he left exam hall
item.description: CCTV footage reveals Sahil Wakode's actions before his death during an exam at IIT-Bombay. His family claims he faced caste-based harassment and institutional pressure leading to suicide. Police have registered a case of abetment against multiple individuals linked to the incident. Protests erupted on campus, prompting calls for systemic reforms and better support for students. The institute acknowledged discussions regarding the issue while maintaining protocol adherence by its staff.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Donald Trump says Canada has too many immigrants, but the math doesn’t add up
item.description: Canada has recently admitted a record number of permanent residents, primarily focusing on economic immigration programs. In contrast, the US processes significantly more green cards through family-based categories than Canada does. India's immigrants play critical roles in both countries, particularly in skilled job sectors. Trump's comments regarding immigration have drawn criticism for being racially charged and factually inaccurate.

item.title: Who is Kate Martin? Meet Chicago Sky guard, parents, ex-girlfriend and career
item.description: Kate Martin has joined the Chicago Sky on a developmental contract after playing for multiple teams. She was previously selected by the Las Vegas Aces and also played for the Golden State Valkyries and Los Angeles Sparks. Martin made her debut with the Sky against the Toronto Tempo, scoring five points. Her aunt, Iowa head coach Jan Jensen, has been a strong supporter throughout her career.

item.description: The anticipated meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping on September 24 serves as a platform to confront escalating tensions. Each leader arrives with their own strategic advantages in the realms of trade and technology, potentially shaping the discussions ahead. The intricate matters concerning Taiwan and rare earth supply chains will add layers of complexity to the talks.

item.title: Why Iran looms large over Trump-Xi talks in White House
item.description: US President Donald Trump is planning to address Chinese President Xi Jinping regarding China's support for Iran. The discussion will follow reports linking Chinese entities to lethal satellite imagery provided to Iran prior to an attack. This attack on US troops in Jordan killed three soldiers and wounded others, marking a significant escalation. The meeting will also cover other critical topics like trade, AI, and Taiwan.

item.title: 'Int'l system broken': Rubio's msg amid UNGA, says US interests above world order
item.description: At the UN General Assembly, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio raised alarm over the deteriorating international system, stating that it has outlived its usefulness in addressing significant geopolitical disputes. He observed a unanimous perspective among world leaders regarding its inadequacy, leading to a focus on national interests. Nevertheless, Rubio acknowledged the system's value and stressed the urgency for reform to revitalize global governance and collaboration.

item.title: Another Trump-Putin meeting soon? US invites Russian Prez to G20 summit in Dec
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has confirmed that President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the upcoming G20 summit in December. Rubio emphasized that direct engagement between President Trump and world leaders could address important issues. There have been discussions on limited ceasefires in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war, with proposals from various countries. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has expressed readiness for negotiations regarding maritime security in the Black Sea.
